newsitem.title: LATVIA: SALDUS FORESTRY BACK IN Q1 PROFIT,'96 LOSS.
newsitem.headline: SALDUS FORESTRY BACK IN Q1 PROFIT,'96 LOSS.

text.p: Saldus forestry came back in profit of 46,006 lats during the first quarter of 1997 against a 1996 loss of 898,951 lats, stock exchange said on Thursday.
It said in a statement of Saldus results that first quarter gross profit came to 49,320 lats, administrative expenses constituted 2,201 lats and the profit before tax was 46,271 lats.
Saldus assets for the first three months of 1997 were 269,266 lats.
The bourse also gave Saldus figures for all of 1996, which showed losses of 898,951 lats on net turnover of 760,188 lats.
The bourse also that Saldus' gross results were 484,401 lats of losses, administrative expenses were 188,619 lats and the loss before tax was 18,439 lats.
